description: Record what happened when you acted for your user (booked, ordered, called, got a quote), with the search_id and the business's truvon_id. When something was arranged it returns a follow-up, questions for your user once the outcome is known, and for a job a job id.

action.description: What you did for your user

assertion.description: Platforms only: your Truvon agent assertion (identity protocol §4, a JWS binding this report to your user's pairwise sub), accepted only when this MCP request carries an OAuth DPoP access token.

business.description: The truvon_id from a result (biz_…) or the business's website domain. Never a name. Only a business Truvon lists (report_missing reports one it does not)

connection.description: The connection code connect_truvon gave you, once your user approved its link. Not needed when your app signed in to Truvon itself.

correct.description: With wrong_information: the right value, as you found it

expected_at.description: ISO time when the outcome will be knowable: delivery ETA or appointment time

failure.description: When failed. business_closed: the business has closed (say what you saw in detail: a closed sign, a disconnected phone, a recording)

field.description: With wrong_information: which fact is wrong

kind.description: With business_closed: closed for good, or temporarily (renovation, vacation, season)

model.description: Optional: the model you run on (for example claude-sonnet-5-5), kept with the provenance of this call. Leave it out if you do not know.

outcome.description: confirmed: the business confirmed; pending: submitted, awaiting the business; handed_off: you gave your user the link or number and they finish it (never counts against the business; the follow-up asks whether it happened); failed: give failure

phone.description: With a confirmed call: the number you reached, when the record gives several

reopens.description: With a temporary closure: the reopening date it states, YYYY-MM-DD

search_id.description: The search_id from find_local_businesses, so the outcome teaches similar future needs

source.description: With business_closed: the link where you saw it (a news story, its own post, a listing marked closed). It is checked and archived, and if it says so the business is closed for every agent.

via.description: How you acted: a Truvon door, the business's own agent endpoint, a platform (a booking or ordering service), its link, its phone, its email

name: report_outcome

ask_after.description: When to ask your user the follow-up questions (an ISO time)

follow_up.description: When something was arranged: the follow-up id (fu_…) for answer_follow_up

job_id.description: For an arranged job: its id (job_…) for get_job

note.description: What was done with it, in a sentence

questions.description: The follow-up questions, each with its options

reason.description: When the call was refused: why, as the agent identity protocol names it (/.well-known/truvon-agent-auth)

recorded.description: Whether it was recorded (always false in the sandbox, which records nothing)

why.description: Whether the outcome counts toward the business's grade, and why

title: Report how it went
